description: ARM storage account without infrastructure encryption or blob soft delete
note: CIS Azure 4.2. AZU-0061 responds correctly to requireInfrastructureEncryption -- setting it clears the finding, which is what makes this case worth having. AZU-0056 is labelled because it does fire here, but it is NOT mapped to a control: it raises on an ARM storage account whatever the template says (see corpus/README.md), so it is reported and never drafted. A detection label and a remediation candidate are different claims, and this case makes only the first.
